text: 【全球央行重估黄金“存放地”】受访人士指出，在地缘政治风险上升、金融制裁工具化的背景下，各国对主权资产安全的认知正在发生深刻变化，黄金的战略价值再度凸显。未来，全球黄金储备布局或将逐步由二战后形成的纽约、伦敦集中存放模式，转向“本土存储为核心、海外多元布局兼顾流动性”的新格局。
text_en: 【Global Central Banks Reassess Gold 'Storage Locations'】Interviewees noted that amid rising geopolitical risks and the instrumentalization of financial sanctions, countries' perceptions of sovereign asset security are undergoing profound changes, and the strategic value of gold is again coming to the fore. In the future, the global distribution of gold reserves may gradually shift from the post-WWII pattern of concentrated storage in New York and London to a new framework of 'domestic storage as the core, with diversified overseas placements balancing liquidity.'
